title: Spiral Matrix
description: Return all elements of a matrix in clockwise spiral order.

data.text: Given an `m x n` matrix `matrix`, return all elements in spiral order.
Track top, bottom, left, right boundaries. Walk right, down, left, up and shrink boundaries after each edge. O(m·n) time, O(1) extra.

data.title: Boundary Tracking O(m·n)

data.text: Use direction vectors (right, down, left, up) and a visited set (or bounds check). O(m·n) time, O(1) extra.

data.title: Direction Vectors O(m·n)
What improved?
data.text: **Time:** O(m·n) both ways. **Space:** O(1) extra. Boundary tracking is usually cleaner because the visited sentinel mutates the input matrix.
